description: Angular component for managing and editing SCADA symbols, including preview, update, download, and widget creation functionalities.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing, previewing, and managing SCADA symbols, including widget creation and image updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form groups, sets up route data subscription, and prepares alias controller.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and resources on component destruction.

methods.name: onApplyScadaSymbolConfig
methods.description: Validates and applies the SCADA symbol configuration, updates image and metadata.

methods.name: onRevertScadaSymbolConfig
methods.description: Reverts to original symbol data.

methods.name: enterPreviewMode
methods.description: Prepares and displays a preview of the current symbol with updated settings.

methods.name: exitPreviewMode
methods.description: Exits preview mode and restores original content.

methods.name: onRevertPreviewSettings
methods.description: Reverts preview settings to previous state.

methods.name: onApplyPreviewSettings
methods.description: Applies current preview settings to the preview widget.

methods.name: tagsUpdated
methods.description: Updates tags list.

methods.name: tagHasStateRenderFunction
methods.description: Checks if a tag has a state render function.

methods.name: tagHasClickAction
methods.description: Checks if a tag has a click action.

methods.name: editTagStateRenderFunction
methods.description: Opens editor for tag's state render function.

methods.name: editTagClickAction
methods.description: Opens editor for tag's click action.

methods.name: onSymbolEditObjectDirty
methods.description: Marks symbol editor as dirty.

methods.name: onSymbolEditObjectValid
methods.description: Marks symbol editor as valid or invalid.

methods.name: updateScadaSymbol
methods.description: Opens dialog to update symbol image content.

methods.name: downloadScadaSymbol
methods.description: Downloads the current symbol as a file.

methods.name: createWidget
methods.description: Creates a new widget from the current symbol and opens save dialog.

methods.name: updatePreviewWidgetSettings
methods.description: Updates the preview widget with new settings.

methods.name: prepareScadaSymbolContent
methods.description: Prepares SVG content with updated metadata.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets component state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes component with symbol data, sets read-only state, and patches form.
